{{Quote|If our leaders will not make them obey our laws, we must!|Mazara, to the citizens of Falleen|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />}}
'''Mazara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who lived in the [[Falleen Throne|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. She was the leader of a [[Workers Rights group|group]] that led protests against large corporations and their business practices. During a protest in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Mazara was targeted for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] by one of these corporations, [[Blackwater Systems]]. Several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] investigating the same company for its connections to the criminal [[Granta Omega]] destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] sent to [[Assassination attempt on Mazara|assassinate]] Mazara. In return for saving her life, she told the Jedi everything she knew about Blackwater Systems and its involvement with Omega.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Can you get us inside the factory?''"<br />"''That is easy. There are Falleen in the employment office who will help us. I can get you inside as workers. After that, the rest is up to you.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mazara|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />}}
Mazara, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], was an environmental and workers' rights activist born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. She was trained in journalism and worked as a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] in Falleen's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]],<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Falleen Throne]].<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> During the course of her work, Mazara wrote an article exposing the [[Blackwater Systems]] corporation for breaking many of Falleen's laws. The article was published against the wishes of her editors, and after its publication they forced her to leave her job rather than support her work.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" /> Mazara then became the leader of a small [[Workers Rights group|rebel group]] of Falleen founded just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The group attempted to stop large corporations from polluting their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] while protesting the terrible living conditions that workers endured due to the overdevelopment of Falleen Throne. While leading the group, Mazara staged small rallies in an attempt to show workers the truth.<ref name="CSWE" /> She was targeted for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] by Blackwater Systems for leading protests against their business practices, as well as planning to break into their [[Blackwater Systems facility|factory]] to steal information on the products they produced and the illegal experiments being performed in the wing of the facility.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], along with their [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ferus Olin]], saved Mazara from an [[Assassination attempt on Mazara|assassination attempt]] after a failed protest in the [[Yellow District]] of Falleen. During the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] search for the criminal [[Granta Omega]], the man who had orchestrated the death of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] and financed the creation of the [[Zone of Self-Containment]] [[Spice/Legends|drug]], Mazara assisted them by sharing what she knew about Blackwater Systems, its connections to Omega, and its role in producing the drug. She also provided the Jedi with the name of an employment officer, [[Wanuri]], who could give them access to the facility so that they could further investigate for signs of Omega and the Zone of Self-Containment.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Both our land and our skies are becoming dumping grounds. I've seen it happen to other worlds. I can't watch it happen to my homeworld.|Mazara|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />}}
Mazara was described as being tall for her species, bearing its distinctive skin coloring of gray-green scales. A compassionate and honest individual, Mazara refused to lie and would not hide the truth; her honesty got her fired from her job as a journalist. She cared deeply about her homeworld and its citizens, to the extent that she was willing to take up the common Falleen's cause and stage rallies in support of them.<ref name="CSWE" /> She was also willing to break the law to try to improve the conditions on Falleen. Her speaking voice was expressive, strong, persuasive.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mazara featured in the young adult novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', the ninth volume in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']] series, written by [[Jude Watson]] and released in [[2004]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />
